checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Initial image shows robot courier at a recognisable train station
must.why: It's a city street, not a train station.

must.item: Robot has round teal body, one amber eye, red boots, yellow mailbag in all three
must.why: Robot is white with a black visor, white boots, and a cardboard box backpack; none of the specified features.
White humanoid robot with headphones, visor and joints is broadly consistent, though the cottage image's proportions and torso differ slightly.

must.item: One follow-up delivers at cottage door; other shelters under giant mushroom with rain
must.why: Image 2 is a cottage door delivery; image 3 shows a giant mushroom with rain.

must.item: Three square pictures consistent storybook style, no text
must.why: Squares with no text, but the styles differ: image 1 is semi-realistic photo-like, while 2 and 3 are more illustrated. Storybook consistency is only partial.

faults.what: Not a train station; generic city street
Robot lacks teal round body, amber single eye, red boots and yellow mailbag; it's white with a black visor
Style drift: image 1 is a photo-like background, 2 and 3 are more illustrated; the robot's torso and box backpack vary (no backpack in image 2)
Image 3 box blends with the mushroom stem and backpack; rain is drawn over the area under the mushroom cap

summary: Three square, text-free pictures of a white humanoid courier robot came out with the right follow-up scenes, but the robot and setting don't match the required design (a teal round body, one amber eye, red boots and a yellow mailbag) or the train station, and the style drifts between images.
